invariants: Nineteen independently declared actual source/native observations match schema version 8, application ownership, STRICT constraints, FTS documents, connection-local live scopes, reopen/reset and foreign refusal.
The native modern database uses the hash-pinned official SQLite 3.51.2 Windows x64 DLL through its public C API; existing CPython sqlite3 connections are not replaced or patched.
Foreign, canonical, unknown-table and corrupt databases are refused before mutating pragmas; tested existing file bytes remain unchanged.
Only recognized derived tables reset on incompatible versions. Current durable generations/documents survive reopen; live tables belong to each connection.
All native prepared execution handles finalize after success, binding failure or SQL error; initialization failure closes the unpublished real database.
The original STRICT table semantics remain enabled. No writable_schema workaround or stripped STRICT keyword is accepted.
identity: Version-8 derived index is disposable and application-qualified; canonical schema-19 stores remain foreign.
ownership: Native database owns a hash-verified DLL handle and each SQLite connection; per-execution statements finalize before publication and schema failure closes its unpublished connection.
ordering: Create missing file, open, inspect application/version/tables, refuse foreign inputs, then apply journal pragmas and persistent/temporary schemas.
errors: SQLite extended codes preserve STRICT/check/type failures; foreign refusal messages match the original schema provider. Public query errors and all configuration types remain separate.
cancellation: This is a synchronous database/schema boundary; public query serialization, caller abort, provider epochs and close draining remain separate.
adaptation: The Windows x64 native C API adapter permits SQLite 3.51.2 alongside CPython's loaded SQLite 3.35.5. Its direct import/subsystem inventory supports implementation assessment; it is not Win7 certification.
open_questions: Full public search/ranking/cursors/reconciliation/generations and schema-19 persistence remain unaccepted.
All JavaScript binding edge cases, statement preparation timing and large-history performance are outside this bounded private adapter.
Owner-only POSIX file modes do not certify Windows ACL semantics. Real Win7 remains deferred.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
